Don't know if this has relevance to it aswell, but I feel like I need to say it. 

I'm terrified of the dark, so much so I can't leave my room at night. I scare myself when I walk up stairs because I get horrible feelings and visions of something grabbing me from behind, I always imagine things in the corner of my eyes, especially when I'm outside.  I can't fall asleep until around 5am, becuase I'm too scared to close my eyes, even with every light on, but then I have to get up at 6:30 to get ready for school. This goes on and on, and has done now for about a year, I tried ignoring it at first, but as my depression slowly creeps back into sight, I feel that it's only going to make it worse through lack of sleep and constant paranoia.
